emissions by 5.1 million tons of CO2e in 2023. We also apply additional renewable energy
certificates to our Scope 3 emissions to reduce emissions associated with fuel- and energy-related
activities, customer use of our consumer hardware, including Meta Quest headsets, and employees
working from home. As a result, we have reduced our value chain emissions by 1.4 M tons of CO2e
